single.rationale: Lyft shows impressive operational improvement with positive operating cash flow ($1.2B) and revenue growth (15.5% 3-year CAGR), but the anomalous $2.9B tax benefit artificially inflates 2025 net income to unsustainable levels. Underlying operating losses persist (-3% margin), international expansion carries execution risk, and intense competition creates uncertainty around sustained profitability absent tax benefits.

team.thesis: Lyft has demonstrated a multi-year operational turnaround with operating cash flow surging from -$237.3M in 2022 to $1.2B in 2025 and net cash of $79.0M, but the business remains operating-unprofitable with operating income of -$188.4M in 2025, deteriorating from -$118.9M in 2024 primarily due to integration costs from two major international acquisitions (Freenow for $236.8M and TBR for $115.2M)
